items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was with Tommy Flanagan, Kenny Burrell, Pepper Adams, and before me the group was Frank Rosolino’s group.

ctx.x: So, the Bluebird in is a place that is often…but it seems like there was an Eastside and a Westside thing happening in Detroit, and how did you fit into all of that?

Yes, there was. I was with the Westside guys. I was with Tommy Flanagan, Kenny Burrell, Pepper Adams, and before me the group was Frank Rosolino’s group. He left to go with Stan Kenton. Kenny Burrell grabbed me and put me in that because I was a Westside guy. Those guys were down there in the valley. They were way downtown and in primarily black schools, high schools and stuff. They were eastside kids, like the movies.
What was the club scene on the eastside like?
